con:mockOperation.con:dispatchPath: import com.eviware.soapui.support.XmlHolder; def holder = new XmlHolder(mockRequest.requestContent); def caseId = holder.getNodeValue("//*[local-name()='caseId']"); def applicantName = holder.getNodeValue("//*[local-name()='applicantName']"); def caseType = holder.getNodeValue("//*[local-name()='caseType']"); def priorityFlag = holder.getNodeValue("//*[local-name()='priorityFlag']"); if (!caseId?.trim() || !applicantName?.trim() || !caseType?.trim() || !priorityFlag?.trim()) { return "FaultResponse"; } else { return "SuccessResponse"; }
